pkgmetadata.longdescription: Mozilla VPN is a WireGuard-based VPN service from Mozilla. This package builds the Linux client from upstream's source release: the Qt 6/QML desktop application, the root daemon it drives over the system D-Bus (mozillavpn linuxdaemon: kernel WireGuard, nftables firewall, cgroup-based split tunnelling), the mozillavpn-obfuscator helper, and the SOCKS5 proxy plus native messaging manifests used by the browser extension. Both daemons get an OpenRC init script unconditionally and a systemd unit with USE=systemd.
